overview: It's one of the world's toughest and most dangerous jobs. And as a nationwide driver shortage threatens to stall Australia's economy, a new generation of Rookie Truckers is stepping in to take the wheel. Guiding them through this baptism-by-fire are Yogi, Steve, and Sludge—three long-haul veterans determined to pass on the torch before they hang up their keys. Facing blowouts, breakdowns, and extreme weather on the open road, the Rookie Truckers are pushed to the limit to earn their stripes—and a full-time job. They meet all kinds of colourful characters as they crisscross the continent. And along the way, fine-tune their survival skills, master the art of bush mechanics, and grow into the truckers who will keep Australia moving. Gritty and gripping, it's a high-stakes all-terrain journey packed with rugged landscapes, real drama, and storylines of mentorship and transformation.
title: Rookie Truckers

overview: In Bon Cop, Bad Cop, David and Martin team up for an investigation that takes them across Canada after the band chief of an Indigenous community in Gaspésie mysteriously disappears. They are joined by a new cadre of cops who are just as unorthodox as they are: Gabrielle, David's daughter, who has her father's stubborn streak; Joe, an intrepid Micmac police officer from Gesgapegiag; and Kim, a Sureté du Québec lieutenant who is generally skeptical of David's methods.
title: Bon Cop, Bad Cop

overview: Three OUTtv stars -- Boomer Banks, Max Konnor, and Joey Mills -- head to Miami for a wild hotel residency, but when Drake Von joins, clashing egos and unresolved drama erupt, turning their "ultimate boys trip" into explosive chaos.
title: Ultimate Boys Trip

overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.
title: Newlyweds

overview: Dan Maher, Aoife Wilson and John Robertson present a weekly roundup of the latest video gaming news, reviews and previews.
title: Videogame Nation

overview: Following a serious error during a raid, Deputy Commissioner Giovanni Buonvino is relegated to a bureaucratic post at the Villa Borghese police station in Rome. But what appears to be a tranquil place turns out to be a microcosm of puzzles, mysteries, and unspeakable secrets.
title: Buonvino - Misteri a Villa Borghese

overview: Tuva and Ronny have a dream of starting a small hotel in Greece. After a brutal life crisis, they now put everything on the line. It turns out something completely different than expected.
title: Tuva & Ronny – eit lite hotell i Hellas

overview: When Phut, a workaholic office employee, gets so drunk that he can't unlock his own room, he accidentally walks into the apartment of a stranger he mistakes for his best friend next door. The next morning, he discovers the truth — the man is Sunday, his friend's twin brother who has just moved in. What begins as an awkward drunken encounter soon turns into regular meetings every Wednesday, Sunday's day off. A carefree hairstylist who values life's simple moments, Sunday is the complete opposite of Phut, whose life revolves around work. Before long, an ordinary midweek day becomes the one Phut looks forward to the most. As love changes the perspective of a man who never knew how to rest, Phut must choose between a life consumed by work… or a heart that wants to pause with his Sunday.
title: My Staycation Boy

overview: Sonya, Yulia, and Nonna have been friends since childhood. Time passes, but it seems the women haven't found their niche yet. Sonya designs and decorates apartments, although she could have become a skilled art historian. Yulia is a talented fashion designer who makes her living by drawing tattoos. Nonna is a qualified, but unpracticing, theater director. After some amusing events, our lovely trio decides to write a book, "How to Get Married and Be Happy."
title: Не ссорьтесь, девочки!

overview: Twelve women linked to organized crime share their reality alongside mobsters, outlaw bikers and street gang members. They reveal secrets and lasting trauma, while experts shed light on the enduring impact on their lives.
title: Liées par le crime

overview: As a young boy Ned discovers that he can return the dead briefly back to life with just one touch. But his random gift isn't without deadly consequences, as he soon finds out. Grown up Ned puts his talent to good use by touching dead fruit and making it ripe with everlasting flavor. He opens a pie shop. But his gift leaves him wary of becoming close to anyone, as beautiful waitress Olive Snook finds out. His life as a pie maker gets more complicated when private investigator Emerson Cod finds out about Ned's secret. Emerson convinces the cash-strapped Ned to help him solve murder cases (and collect a hefty reward fee) by raising the dead and getting them to name their killers.
title: Pushing Daisies

overview: "The Hollywood News Report" is a weekly half-hour show brings viewers inside the velvet ropes with insider information from the entertainment industry. "The Hollywood News Report" features major theatrical releases through coverage of premieres from the red carpet and film festivals. The movie coverage also includes how films are doing at the box office. And like with any entertainment news show, celebrity news and interviews are a regular part of the program, with some celebrity gossip also thrown in on occasion.
title: The Hollywood News Report

overview: An investigation into one of Turkey's most shocking cases -- and how one man was able to enact total control over a tight-knit family.
title: Palu Ailesi: Karanlık Sarmal

overview: Game of 2 Halves host Laura McGoldrick referees NZ's favourite chaotic comedy quiz. Kiwi sporting legends and NZ's funniest people enter a brutal battle arena of sporting trivia and comedic chaos.
title: Game of 2 Halves

overview: Ready Gamer Mum is a high-energy, funny competition series that flips the gaming world on its head. Ten of the country's best bedroom gamers go head-to-head – but there's a catch – their mums will be in charge of the controllers! They'll need to coach, motivate and somehow transform their mums into champions, but adding to the chaos, each episode features a real-life challenge inspired by that week's videogame – forcing the players and their mums into the real world to recreate what's on screen, with outrageous and hilarious outcomes.
title: Ready Gamer Mum

overview: Chiharu Saeki and Wataru Toda are two high school students who share a common hobby. They love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends until one day, their relationship takes a sudden twist. What does it mean to love someone? What can you really do about it? Follow the story of their adolescence and relationship as it unfolds through a brilliant summer.
title: My Summer of You

overview: A Cappella was NRK's national competition for children's and youth choirs airing between 1992 and 1994. The series consisted of four episodes, including semi-finals for children's choirs and youth choirs (mixed and equal voices), as well as a final.
title: A Cappella

overview: Program hosts Marit Sofie and Ravna invite children to join in marking the International Year of the World's Indigenous People; 1993.
title: A4

overview: A tribute to Norwegian popular music. Host Rune Larsen has his regular supporting players Jan Eggum and Atle Halstensen in the studio.
title: Absolutt norsk

overview: Humor series with a Finn who cooks psycho soup, sheep farmer Odin Jensenius who believes in the individual, two 12-year-olds who always sit on the bench, two cool Tromsø students and a number of other funny things. Sometimes with the trio Ivar Nergaard, Klaus Joacim Sonstad and Hans Petter Nilsen.
title: Adamseplene: Full pupp

overview: Jeremy Borash has all the latest news, action and results from TNA. The show also features exclusive interviews with the stars of the sport.
title: TNA Xplosion

overview: Postcards from the Middle East signed Odd Karsten Tveit.
title: Adventskort

overview: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she's about to enter.
title: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss

overview: This bold and contemporary reimagining brings The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo into the present, grounded in the characters and investigative DNA of Stieg Larsson's Millennium novels, with themes that carry heightened relevance today.
title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

overview: Liza and Alexandra Smirnov are sisters, but no two people could be more different. The elder, Alexandra, is a demon, using people for her own ends, heedless of the consequences. The younger is an angel incarnate: everyone's favorite, an excellent student, and her parents' hope. Alexandra has always envied her sister, and at her sister's wedding, even to spite Liza, she seduced the groom. This was the last straw for the girls' father—in a fit of anger, he revealed a secret the family had kept hidden for years: Alexandra isn't his biological daughter; he married her mother while she was already pregnant. Shocked by this news, the elder sister leaves. Now she will seek revenge—on her parents for lying, and on her sister for receiving more love than her.
title: Мой близкий враг

overview: Six students must face different lessons in love — a love closer than they ever imagined, a love they must run to catch up with, and a love that returns carrying an old promise — before they can grow, hearts and all, through "LOVE×3 The Mandatory Love Course." X1: The love story of a high school boy secretly in love with his best friend — only to be roped in as Cupid, helping him woo someone else. X2: The love story of a senior student council president who must win the heart — and the LINE ID — of the school's most adorable underclassman star. X3: The love story of a younger student bound by an old promise, secretly in love with his own brother's best friend — keep waiting, or let it go?
title: LOVEx3

overview: Francesca Wood and Marty Scurll host the weekly talk show which brings British fans up to date with the latest from the world of British and American professional wrestling.
title: Wrestle Talk TV

overview: This heartwarming and inspirational drama revolves around the growth and struggles of an amateur football team in Changzhou. Composed of ordinary citizens, the team suffers one crushing defeat after another, yet never once gives up. From a bleak and dismal start, the players gradually rally together under the guidance of their coach and the unwavering support of their families and the entire city, ultimately earning both respect and hard-won growth.
title: Changzhou Never Quits
The First Sight of Nanyang Overseas Chinese

overview: In the twenty-fourth year of the Changhe era, the death of the founding emperor sparks a fierce battle for the throne. Yan Qingshu is falsely accused and forced into a broken engagement, only to witness the destruction of her family. After being rescued by Xiao Jingyan, the two form an alliance and return to the capital seeking revenge. Together, they uncover the treasonous schemes of Prince Ling, the Xie family, and other powerful forces conspiring against the throne. Through countless life-and-death trials, their partnership gradually deepens into love. In the end, they join forces to expose every conspiracy, overcome the chaos of a turbulent era, and restore peace and order to the nation.
title: Vow in Ashes

overview: On a journey inspired by iconic Korean seafood dishes, filmmaker Sonya Lee and journalist Hannah Sung uncover the deep links between cultural identity and ocean conservation.
title: Our Ocean Table

overview: With the first place in a university business competition and a father running a time-honored leather bag store, Yusuke Tsuruta is in the "outstanding" category among university students. After graduation, Yusuke decides to start a business with his classmate Kengo Sato. After declaring that "Company is not school!", he works hard every day to make his business successful.
title: A Company Isn't A School!

overview: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.
title: Entre padre e hijo

overview: Honey I Bought the House is a nail-biting approach to the reality of buying a first home, which sees couples given a £15,000 deposit to get them on the property ladder. The only catch is they are separated immediately and one has three weeks to secure a property - or they lose the money. The hunt is on for the perfect home. Will their partner be thrilled with their new property and sign the mortgage papers, or risk losing that precious deposit?
title: Honey I Bought the House

overview: Renowned Turkish painter Osman Hamdi Bey's "In Front of the Green Mosque" is sold to a private foundation for a hefty sum but is stolen during the transfer. An underground network attempts to smuggle it from a decaying warehouse, unwittingly bringing together a group of strangers with clashing motives. Among them are criminals, vengeful lovers, a grieving bird breeder, a runaway banker, and a kidnapped taxi driver. Unaware of the larger scheme, they find themselves entangled in a high-stakes clash over stolen art.
title: P.A.Y.
The Thought Verification Zone: The Community

overview: WILD takes over the DR in Baddies Gone Wild's sophomore season.
title: Baddies Gone Wild: Dominican Republic

overview: "Hot Ones" spin-off series where guests answer questions and play a variation of Beer Pong.
title: Hot Ones Wing Pong

overview: Sometimes we feel like we know more about their lives than we do about our own. Their names are on everyone's lips. They are famous. They are stars. But all stars fade sooner or later. And humans too die. However, the death of a famous person is an event that leaves no one indifferent. They left us in different ways. Some left young, in the prime of their creative powers. Others lived long and fruitful lives. But no matter when they passed, their death is an irreparable loss for the entire country. In its new program, "How Idols Passed Away," DTV will reveal unknown details of the final days of great Russian figures, idols of recent times—outstanding actors and directors, poets and writers, TV presenters, and masters of sport.
title: Как уходили кумиры

overview: Melanie Sykes presents the cooking competition with a difference. In each episode four contestants battle it out in various cooking tests judged by Marco Piere White. The winner stands to walk away with £2,500, however at the end of each round the competitors get to judge each others dishes as well and have a chance at stealing money away from the prize fund at the risk of leaving the competition.
title: Humble Pie

overview: For the Froglets, the human world is a giant playground full of everyday challenges and wonders that spark an urge to adapt, get creative, play and have lots of fun along the way.
title: Froglets
Small Town Escapes With Colin and Justin

overview: Lisa Vanderpump has been ruling over the Las Vegas strip for years now, with three hotspot restaurants serving up chic cocktails in her signature whimsical settings. Now, she is expanding her Vegas empire through the opening of her high-profile namesake hotel. In this limited series, we follow the behind-the-scenes dash to make the property worthy of the Vanderpump brand. LVP shares what inspired her newest enterprise and pulls back the curtain on the down-to-the-wire drama. The series will culminate at The Vanderpump Hotel's lavish opening party, with fan-favorite Bravolebrities celebrating the launch.
title: Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas

overview: One day, an ancient ring associated with the Indian legend of Raja and the magic stone that can transport its owner's consciousness into the body of the heir to the throne falls into the hands of Vasily Lebedev, a simple man with a complex personality who drives a taxi in Chelyabinsk. Now, whenever he faces danger, Vasily finds himself in India, in the body of a young Rajesh, the heir to an ancient royal family. With a second chance in a different body, Vasily sets out to redefine his life, regain the trust of his wife Maria, mend his relationship with his son Sasha, and become the person he always wanted to be.
title: Челябинский раджа

overview: Dastane Yek Shahr is an Iranian television drama series created by Asghar Farhadi that follows a diverse team of young journalists and producers working on a social documentary program called "In the City" for Tehran's Network 5. As they investigate and report on various contemporary social issues facing urban Iran, the personal lives, relationships, and moral dilemmas of the crew members become inextricably linked to the stories they cover, creating a meta-narrative that blends documentary realism with character-driven fiction.
title: Dastane Yek Shahr

overview: Paloma, a humble young woman, marries Porfirio Cruz, a wealthy landowner in San Luis Potosí. During a local fair, she meets Renato, and an undeniable attraction sparks between them. Torn by guilt, Paloma returns to the hacienda to care for her ailing husband. As Porfirio's health declines, he entrusts his estate to his friend Gustavo, who secretly plots to take control by installing his protégé, Renato, as administrator. Renato's arrival reignites his connection with Paloma, trapping her in a loveless marriage while confronting her true feelings. But as tensions rise, Bárbara, Paloma's daughter, also falls for Renato, unaware of their past. Mother and daughter soon find themselves on opposite sides of a forbidden love, becoming rivals for the same man.
title: Mi Rival

overview: Nurse the Dead follows Noa Reyes, a driven Filipina nurse supervisor whose ability to see ghosts — referred to as her "third eye" — makes her the go-to handler for a hospital ward teeming with restless spirits. Juggling demanding apparitions alongside staff burnout, family pressures and a coworker who seems to know more about her than expected, the series grounds its supernatural premise in the cultural specificity of the Filipino healthcare experience.
title: Nurse the Dead

overview: Coverage of the annual Red Bull X-Fighters FMX competition.
title: Red Bull X-Fighters

overview: The Golden Elevators turns seemingly simple A or B questions into a game like no other, as ten contestants take on the game, each other, and two elevators in a bid to reach the penthouse and a huge cash jackpot.
title: The Golden Elevators

overview: Wordle challenges players to solve five-letter word puzzles in a battle of smarts, speed and fun. It builds on the way the puzzle community engages with Wordle every day — solving together, sharing wins, debating strategies and cheering one another on. Now, that style of play comes to life as the most obsessed and competitive players will team up in squads and go head-to-head in the Wordle arena, playing for an incredible cash prize.
title: Wordle

overview: In Escorted, a divorced dad in Manhattan accidentally becomes a male escort in this romantic comedy about sexual dynamic, keeping secrets, and whether real intimacy can ever be bought.
title: Escorted

overview: Rose Hill follows best friends and neighbors West Belmont, a rancher with commitment issues, and brooding record label owner Ford Grant, aka Forbes' "World's Hottest Billionaire," who's long carried a torch for West's sister, Rosie. And when country-pop star Skylar Stone breezes into their rugged mountain town, the heat gets turned way up in this romantic family drama.
title: Rose Hill

overview: Ride or Die follows best friends Debbie Claybourne and Judith Burton who thought they knew everything about each other, except Judith turns out to be an international assassin. When a mysterious figure emerges from Judith's past and a hit goes horribly wrong, both of their worlds are turned upside down as they're forced to go on the run together. It's a race against time and a road trip across Europe, with law enforcement, highly trained assassins, and some very dangerous criminals at their heels.
title: Ride or Die

overview: The Last Gentlemen's Club is a gathering of select representatives of the art of comedy. Here, news is discussed, global issues are addressed, and the traditions of true gentility are upheld. Wit, manners, and nobility are highly valued, but being a gentleman is a privilege that must be earned.
title: КЛУБ ПОСЛЕДНИХ ДЖЕНТЛЬМЕНОВ

overview: An interactive stand-up show where each comedian only has 1 minute to perform, after which they stay on stage and interact with the hosts. Unpredictable interviews, no censorship, and multiple comedians at once.
title: Стендап за 60 секунд

overview: In each episode Tim Warwood and Adam Gendle are randomly dropped into various UK locations and with the props they are given they have to dream up and execute the incredible.
title: The Indestructibles

overview: Notes is a show podcast where Seva Lovkachev and Kolya Andreev scourge each other's notes in an attempt to find the explosive shit that will make them popular.
title: ЗАМЕТКИ

overview: Alexey Stakhovich's "December Madness" podcast series is about the festive mood, traditions, gifts, and the atmosphere on the eve of the New Year.
title: Декабрьское безумие

overview: Five young students from other Iranian cities studying in Tehran rent a house and live together. Each of these five people has a different personality and they encounter a new story in each episode. But in the end, they help each other overcome the problems. Reliable airdates for the episodes/seasons are virtually impossible to find. Season 1 aired somewhere between March 1998 - March 1999 (1377, Solar Hijri). Season 2 aired somewhere between March 1999 - March 2000 (1378, Solar Hijri). Season 3 aired in 2021 (1399, Solar Hijri).
title: Roozegar-e Javani

overview: Khan Baba and Raba Khanum have been caretakers of Agha Bozor's house since they were young, and now that they have reached old age, the residents of the house no longer visit them. One day before Ramadan, Hamid, one of the grandsons of Agha Bozor, comes home and asks Khan Baba to imprison him in one of the rooms of the house.
title: Yadashthaye koodaki

overview: Siavash is interested in a girl named Maryam. He wants to marry her despite her family's opposition, but the girl's family is not very interested in this marriage. One of the conditions that the girl's family leaves to marry the boy is his acceptance in the university entrance exam, so Siavash joins with several of his friends, Mohsen, Ramin, Majid, Hamed, each of whom has special conditions and different motivations of studying.
title: Poshte Konkooriha

overview: Suisui, the young mistress of the Mystic Crow Clan, is blessed with great fortune and can communicate with beasts. But after being mistaken for a jinx, she is abandoned at a mass grave. After crashing a marquis manor banquet, she saves Xiao Heng, the cursed Prince Jing. With her divine powers and clever mind, Suisui breaks curses, drives away evil, outsmarts schemers, exposes hidden palace secrets, and helps the prince reclaim his strength. From a feared "jinx" to a beloved lucky princess, she joins forces with her father to defy fate and turn their destinies around.
title: The Crow Princess of Fortune
Bao Ye De Xiao Zu Zong You A You Sa

overview: The Roman is set in the high-stakes, sharp-elbowed present-day Las Vegas casino business, which is a modernized but still dangerous version of the legendary city. At the center of which stands Robert "Bobby Red" Redman, president of the hottest hotel casino in town, who has to make some long odds moves to try and secure his position and take more ground.
title: The Roman

overview: Jason Manford hosts the show in which forty strangers put their own money on the line in order to invest in fledgling businesses that may make them a fortune.
title: Money Pit

overview: Retired army brigadier Garnet Wellington-Bull struggles to adjust to civilian life.
title: The Adventures of Brigadier Wellington-Bull

overview: Three gay men, Frank O'Dowd, Steve Bie, and Gene Stavis, came together during the mid-1970's in New York City to form Truth, Justice, and the American Way, Inc. As a company, they produced a show for community access cable television called The Emerald City which covered a variety of issues in the gay community. The program aired in New York City on Manhattan Cable's Channel J beginning in March 1977 and was syndicated in San Francisco. Originally an hour long show, it switched to a half-hour in the fall of 1977. The Emerald City ran from 1977 to 1978 and had both gay and non-gay commercial sponsors.
title: The Emerald City

overview: The critically acclaimed docuseries UNTOLD pulls back the curtain on epic tales from the wild world of football. And yes, we mean football. Each character-driven story hinges on candid, intimate first-person accounts from those who lived it.
title: Untold UK

overview: Two D's and a Dog follows Dotty Charles after the death of her father, as she travels with her friend Dingle Bell and her dog Fido in search of work.
title: Two D's and a Dog

overview: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up. In the end, 99 chefs will be eliminated, and one talented home cook will prove they are the best of the best with a chance to win up to $250,000.
title: 100 Cooks

overview: A fresh take on a classic, Restaurant Impossible: Last Call follows acclaimed chef Aarón Sánchez and dynamic Canadian restaurateur Jen Agg as they lead the charge to rescue struggling restaurants across North America. This isn't about a quick fix - it's about digging into real problems, adapting to a new and challenging restaurant industry, and finding creative, unexpected solutions tailored to each business. While Jen tackles design and front-of-house issues, Aarón gets to work on the culinary side, each assessing exactly what needs to change for the restaurant to thrive. From horrendous Yelp reviews and staff DMs for help to feuding family members, each episode reflects the varying challenges facing today's restaurateurs. Emotions are high, and the stakes are critical as Aarón and Jen strategize each location's rescue plan, all while navigating the greater changes happening in an industry being forced to evolve.
title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call

overview: Dan the Donut Man follows Dan Cole – self-proclaimed "Donut Daddy" and Chief Donut Development Engineer at Dunkin' – as he travels across America in search of culinary inspiration for his innovative, outrageous and sometimes unhinged donuts. After soaking up each city he visits, Dan heads back to his Donut Lab, where he translates those experiences and flavors into two wild donut concepts. Armed with his creations, he returns to the city for taste tests with locals, who determine which donut best represents their hometown. Some donuts will have fans drooling while others may have them scratching their heads – but they'll all have everyone talking about Dan the Donut Man.
title: Dan the Donut Man

overview: Wildcard Kitchen: High Rollers at Sea takes host Eric Adjepong's game beyond the kitchen and into international waters, where the rules are different and anything can happen. In this arced tournament, Eric's invited some of the most memorable chefs from his table. The ones wild enough to say yes, bold enough to compete at sea and talented enough to handle whatever chaos comes their way. Who will be the last chef at the table with the biggest pot of money the game has ever seen.
title: Wildcard Kitchen: High Rollers at Sea

overview: Charismatic Texas real estate agent Noel Collier will flex her specialty of helping clients with the most wildly unique property requests find their dream homes in the new HGTV series Extreme Buyers Club. During the season, she'll step into each buyer's surprising—and sometimes shocking—world to experience how they live and then scour the market for out-of-the-box listings that fit their unprecedented wish list. Whether a recent divorcée seeking acreage for dozens of llamas, a ghost-obsessed couple searching for a haunted home, or a professional mermaid needing lots of water, no house hunt will prove too extreme for Noel and her team.
title: Extreme Buyers Club

overview: Roast My Rental, comedian, truth-teller and design enthusiast Leslie Jones will crash America's worst short-term rentals, whose viral photos of amenities gone wrong, misleading listings and brutally honest reviews have scared guests away. After Leslie's hilarious roast of the property and a no-nonsense reality check, she and her experienced design team led by HGTV star and home renovation expert Jasmine Roth will come to the rescue and help the owners clean up the chaos in just 72 hours. They'll fix the flaws, transform the houses into top-tier vacation escapes and give the ‘roastees' a chance at redemption when the next guests come to stay.
title: Roast My Rental

overview: A Very Haunted Renovation, will follow six brave renovators and designers who will stay at one of the most haunted houses in America for 31 days with only one mission: completing the renovations.
title: A Very Haunted Renovation

overview: House Shock, unsuspecting homeowners nominated by their sneaky loved ones will receive surprise makeovers for the spaces they've neglected, abandoned or just plain hate. Series host and designer Arielle Vandenberg along with a resourceful construction team led by builder and former Battle on the Beach winner Steve Lewis will keep each edge-of-your-seat renovation on track and on time. With secret planning, stealthy distractions to keep the recipient away, hidden cameras and dramatic room reveals, the 20-episode season will deliver heart, humor and the occasional shock—because not every reno surprise is exactly what a homeowner wished for.
title: House Shock
